recent_posts.title: Tauri Board Elections 2025
recent_posts.summary: Tauri is holding Board Director elections for 2025, with 5 seats available for 2-year terms. Candidates must apply by July 7th with a written introduction covering their background and vision for the Board. Voting by Working Group Members runs July 7-14, with results announced by July 19. The Board governs the cross-platform app building toolkit under The Commons Conservancy structure, using staggered elections to maintain continuity.

recent_posts.title: Experimental Tauri Verso Integration
recent_posts.summary: Tauri has introduced an experimental integration of Verso, a browser engine based on Servo, to enhance developer experience and application performance. This integration aims to provide a more efficient, flexible, and Rust-centric webview solution for Tauri applications. Verso simplifies the interaction with the Servo engine through a more ergonomic and higher-level API, making it easier for developers to leverage Servo's capabilities without dealing with its complexities. The new custom runtime, tauri-runtime-verso, supports Tauri's CLI, modern frontend frameworks, official plugins, comprehensive window management, and hot module replacement for an improved development workflow.

recent_posts.title: Announcing Tauri 1.7.0
recent_posts.summary: Tauri 1.7.0 introduces several bug fixes, performance improvements, and backported features from the upcoming v2 release. Key updates include optimized `Command::execute` API, custom Windows codesign scripts, RPM bundle support, and configurable DMG installers. Update NPM and Cargo dependencies to the latest version to benefit from these improvements.

recent_posts.title: Tauri Board Elections 2024
recent_posts.summary: The Tauri Programme, celebrating its third anniversary under The Commons Conservancy, is gearing up for its next round of Board Director elections. There are two open seats for election this year, with candidates required to apply by July 5th, 2024. Voting will take place from July 7th to July 12th, with results announced by July 16th. The post also highlights opportunities for community involvement, especially in contributing to Tauri v2 documentation through various Working Group domains.

recent_posts.title: Rust Security Advisory CVE-2024-24576
recent_posts.summary: A security vulnerability, CVE-2024-24576, has been identified in the Rust Standard Library on Windows. Tauri projects may be affected if they use certain features and pass untrusted input to `cmd.exe` or batch files. Users should upgrade to Rust version 1.77.2 immediately.

recent_posts.title: Announcing Tauri 1.6.0
recent_posts.summary: Tauri 1.6.0 has been released with several new features and important bug fixes. Highlights include improved code signing on macOS, enhanced updater functionalities, and a fix for an event loop crash affecting all platforms. Users are advised to update their NPM and Cargo dependencies to the new release.

recent_posts.title: Announcing the Tauri v2 Beta Release
recent_posts.summary: Tauri v2.0.0-beta.0 has been released, introducing mobile support for Android and iOS, enhanced permissions with Access Control List, revamped IPC for better performance, and multiwebview support. New JavaScript APIs for menus, tray icons, and context menus have been added, along with several new window and mobile APIs. The API is currently under audit for stability, with a stable release expected soon.

recent_posts.title: Strengthening Tauri: Our Partnership with CrabNebula
recent_posts.summary: Tauri has partnered with CrabNebula to enhance the stability and security of its open-source framework for multi-platform application development. CrabNebula's full-time engineers are vital in maintaining and advancing Tauri, including securing its 2.0 release. This partnership revolves around open-source values and long-term strategic benefits, ensuring that Tauri evolves according to community needs. A new #crabnebula channel on Tauri's Discord will facilitate direct community engagement and feedback.

recent_posts.title: Announcing Tauri 1.5.0
recent_posts.summary: Tauri 1.5.0 introduces key enhancements including improved resources bundling, code signing improvements, migration to notarytool on macOS, and support for the Bun package manager. Users should update both NPM and Cargo dependencies. Notarytool replaces altool for notarization, code signing is enhanced for all executables, and new configuration options are provided for Windows protocols.

recent_posts.title: Roadmap to Tauri 2.0
recent_posts.summary: Tauri 2.0, targeted for early 2024, aims to be 'The Mobile Update' offering support for iOS and Android. Key features include a powerful new plugin system, and bindings for Swift and Kotlin, enabling platform-specific code. The roadmap outlines three milestones: entering beta phase (feature-complete and secure), release candidate (community testing and feedback), and stable release. Community involvement is encouraged through testing prerelease versions, contributing to documentation, and supporting others.

top_posts.title: Announcing the Tauri Mobile Alpha Release
top_posts.summary: Tauri has released the alpha version 2.0.0-alpha.0 for mobile applications. Users can now update their NPM and Cargo dependencies to this version. Tauri allows adaptation of existing desktop applications for mobile use or the initiation of a new project. Known issues include TLS support and running on a device with Xcode 14.
